scripts.dev:prepare: AI_USAGE_SVELTEKIT_PHASE=check bun --no-env-file svelte-kit sync && CI=1 bun --bun panda codegen --silent && CI=1 bun --bun panda cssgen --silent
scripts.dev:standalone: bun --filter @ai-usage/design-system build && bun run dev:prepare && bun run dev
scripts.check: bun --filter @ai-usage/design-system build && bun run dev:prepare && bun run typecheck
scripts.check:svelte: AI_USAGE_SVELTEKIT_PHASE=check bun --no-env-file svelte-kit sync && AI_USAGE_SVELTEKIT_PHASE=check bun --no-env-file svelte-check --tsconfig ./tsconfig.json
scripts.test:e2e: bun --filter @ai-usage/design-system build && bun run dev:prepare && bun --bun playwright test
scripts.test:e2e-production: bun --bun playwright test --config playwright.production.config.ts e2e/production-report.spec.ts && bun --bun playwright test --config playwright.session-scroll.config.ts e2e/session-scroll.scale.ts
